terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.content:
1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing and using the Tashira E-Visa Portal, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

2. Service Description

Tashira provides electronic visa application processing services for the United Arab Emirates. We act as an intermediary between applicants and UAE immigration authorities.

3. Application Process

All applications are subject to review and approval by UAE immigration authorities. Submission of an application does not guarantee visa approval.

4. Fees and Payments

Visa application fees are non-refundable once processing has begun. Fees cover the cost of processing and service provision only.

5. Document Accuracy

Applicants are responsible for ensuring all submitted documents and information are accurate and authentic. Providing false information may result in application rejection and legal consequences.

6. Processing Times

Standard processing takes 2-4 working days. Express processing takes 24-72 business hours. Processing times are estimates and may vary.

7. Visa Validity

Visa validity periods are determined by UAE immigration authorities. Overstaying may result in fines starting at AED 50 per day and potential travel bans.

8. Privacy

Your personal information is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

9. Limitation of Liability

Tashira is not liable for delays, rejections, or changes in visa policies by UAE immigration authorities.

10. Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of updated terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
1. Information Collection

We collect personal information necessary for visa application processing, including name, contact details, passport information, and travel details.

2. Use of Information

Your information is used solely for visa application processing and related communications. We do not sell or share your data with third parties except as required by UAE immigration authorities.

3. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access or disclosure.

4. Data Retention

Personal data is retained for the period necessary to complete the visa application process and as required by applicable laws.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. Contact us at info@tashira.me for data-related requests.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.content:
1. General Policy

Visa application fees are generally non-refundable as they cover processing costs incurred by our service and UAE immigration authorities.

2. Non-Refundable Cases

Fees are non-refundable in the following cases:
- Application rejection by immigration authorities
- Withdrawal after processing has begun
- Providing incorrect or incomplete information
- Change of travel plans

3. Exceptional Circumstances

In rare cases where processing has not yet begun, a partial refund may be considered at our discretion, minus administrative fees.

4. Processing Errors

If an error occurs due to our system, we will work to resolve the issue or provide a refund at our discretion.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.content:
1. What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide and improve our services.

2. How We Use Cookies

We use cookies for:
- Essential website functionality
- Remembering your preferences (such as language selection)
- Analyzing website usage to improve our service

3. Types of Cookies

Essential Cookies: Required for the website to function properly.
Preference Cookies: Remember your settings and choices.
Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website.

4. Managing Cookies

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may affect website functionality.
